comment: Catalog of the public single-file projects released by 3legsbird on the Telegram channel 'Html codes' (https://t.me/html_codee). Each entry keeps a link to the original Telegram post as its source of truth. Regenerate the site with `npm run build:site`.

channel.name: Html codes
channel.author: 3legsbird
channel.note: Every project below is a self-contained single .html file: open it in a browser, no build step, no server.

projects.title: Super Intelligence
projects.summary: All the popular AI platforms in one single-file web app, with chat management, HTML preview and Python execution.
features: ChatGPT, Claude and DeepSeek in one interface
Preview HTML and run Python inline

projects.title: Presentation AI
projects.summary: PowerPoint rebuilt as one HTML file: AI writes the slides, AI draws the pictures, and the deck exports to PPTX.
features: Free AI images via Pollinations.ai — no API key

projects.title: TelePulse AI
projects.summary: Telegram channel analytics and strategy suite: point it at any public channel URL and get an audit plus a growth plan.
features: AI audit, SWOT and content breakdown
7-day growth calendar with a monetization plan
AI post creator with live Telegram preview
Analyzes any public channel from a single URL

projects.title: AI MindGrapher
projects.summary: Turns a complex idea, study topic or research prompt into an interactive 3D/2D mind map.

projects.title: Offline AI Background Remover
projects.summary: AI image background remover that needs no API key and keeps working offline from the second use on.

projects.title: AI Image Detector
projects.summary: Fully working detector that tells whether an image was generated by AI.
features: Drop an image, get a verdict

projects.title: Gemini TTS
projects.summary: Text-to-speech web app built on the Gemini API, packed into a single small HTML file.

projects.title: Hacker AI
projects.summary: Terminal-style AI interface with a hacker aesthetic; a live preview runs as a Telegram mini-app.

projects.title: Hacker AI v2
projects.summary: Second, much larger build of the terminal-style AI interface.

projects.title: Real Racing 3D
projects.summary: 3D racing in one HTML file — race against AI opponents or against another player peer-to-peer.
features: Updated design and mechanics (revision of 12 Oct 2026)

projects.title: 3D Drift King
projects.summary: Drift, dodge, score, survive: an endless neon highway with traffic coming both ways.
features: Endless neon highway and night city lighting
Dynamic engine audio, crash shake and flash

projects.title: Gravity Flip

projects.title: Neon Horizon Racer V2

Bookmarks, History, Settings and the Dino game
